read.title: Plan to Combine Cleanser Listings
read.text:
Team,

Right now, our gel cleanser is sold on three separate listings: 120ml, 200ml, and a two-pack. Each listing has its own reviews, so customers see only a few on each page.

I propose we merge the three listings into one parent listing with size variations. As a result, all reviews would appear together, which usually helps conversion.

Before we consolidate, I'll check that the product names and ingredients match exactly. I'll open a case with Seller Support if we need help.

Yuri

Hi team,

Our cream is sold on two listings, 50ml and 100ml. I suggest we merge them into one parent listing with size variations. As a result, customers will see all the reviews in one place, which should help our conversion rate. What do you think?

Thanks,
